results: The main header displayed all six links in English and Arabic: Solutions, Capabilities, Industries, Architecture, How to build and Integrations.
The homepage hero video was playing in each locale. Its currentTime was greater than zero and playback controls were absent.
Direct entry displayed the selected Sales workflow in Arabic.
The catalogue index and detail tracks measured 272px and 912px. The facts occupied three 288px columns.
Keyboard interaction selected Finance and Connections and opened the integration requirements within the same localized Solutions pathname.
Reload and the switch to English retained the selected workflow and capability. The inner requirements disclosure could be reopened in the restored context.

On /ar/services, the Customer experience category and search narrowed the catalogue to Agent Assist. Opening its standalone page and using browser Back restored the category, search and selected capability.
The mobile industry selector displayed Logistics and its workflow. The selection and workflow survived switching between Arabic and English, and the facts occupied one column.
The Arabic Sales facts occupied one 350px column with no horizontal overflow.

designAcceptance.source: The user subsequently rejected the sidebar design in a message with a screenshot. The attachment was not copied into the repository.
designAcceptance.scope: The functional results above do not establish design acceptance.
